gen-gf-oxanium-gf-miriam-libre: Miriam Libre reads friendly and modern, with an s that opens wide. Over a full page its wire-thin strokes and big lowercase keep going smoothly, while Oxanium brings the commanding edge up top.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Laser-cut crispness meets very large lowercase eyes. Mochiy Pop One does the steady work of reading, letters hung along the line, while Oxanium does the commanding work with uninterrupted monoline strokes.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Mochiy Pop P One spaces its letters generously and keeps a sizable lowercase. Mochiy Pop P One gives the commanding Oxanium headings a widely spaced, approachable partner, with monoline strokes above and open rhythm below.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-montserrat-underline: Montserrat Underline draws round, unswelling bowls and counters that breathe, with a lowercase that looks oversized beside its own capitals. Oxanium is best at commanding attention; Montserrat Underline is best at steady text.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-mozilla-headline: Approachable and contemporary, Mozilla Headline fills its lines with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal. And Oxanium draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, so the body text can stay modest in size.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-mozilla-text: Oxanium holds one unbroken stroke from stem to bowl, which gives its tall lowercase real command. Mozilla Text brings tall-bodied, flared-terminal lowercase that looks bold, so the two share confident weight.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads clean and contemporary, with a large central band and wide-mouthed curves drawn with technical-pen steadiness. And Oxanium sets the commanding tone at the top, leaving the text to carry on quietly.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-nobile: Nobile keeps its capitals barely taller than its lowercase, with open letter mouths. Nobile moves through extended text with a professional, contemporary ease, a quiet foil for the commanding Oxanium.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-nokora: Clean and generously open in the s, Nokora lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line. But a full column of it stays inviting, while Oxanium keeps a flat fineliner line up front.
gen-gf-oxanium-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic keeps a welcoming gap in its c and sets capitals only slightly above lowercase, for a modern, clean look. Oxanium commands with rounded-rod strokes; Noto Kufi Arabic quietly carries the text.
